readme:
# DESIGN:OS 3D Blender

**An MCP server and agent skill for Blender 5.2.** Your coding agent models, renders and checks mechanical parts on your machine: four tools, an `AGENT_OK` contract, and a 3D-print production gate. Specs are locked to millimeters. Exports are STL and glTF. FREE + source-available ([PolyForm Shield 1.0.0](LICENSE)).

Quickstart · What it makes · How it works · Install · Limits

## Quickstart **In Claude Code:** ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender /plugin install design-os-3d-blender@design-os-3d-blender ``` **From a clone** (Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, or a standalone MCP client): ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender.git cd design-os-3d-blender python3 scripts/self_check.py pip install . ``` Point your MCP client at the installed command, and set `BLENDER_BIN` to your Blender 5.2 binary: ```json { "mcpServers": { "design-os-3d-blender": { "command": "design-os-3d-blender", "env": { "BLENDER_BIN": "/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender" } } } } ``` On Linux the binary is often `/usr/bin/blender`. The first tool will tell you if it cannot find it. If you use `uv`, `uv run design-os-3d-blender` from this repository starts the same server, with no need to publish a package. Ask for a part in plain English. A typical pass validates a `spec.json`, runs a headless bpy script, and stops on one line: `AGENT_OK` or `AGENT_FAIL`. ## What it makes These are real builds from this repository, made in Blender 5.2 through the agent pipeline.

| Build | What it is | In this repo | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | CK-001 | A compact keyboard, from photo and spec to a printable kit | [`docs/reviews/ck-001/r02`](docs/reviews/ck-001/r02) | | DC-01 | A desk robot: printed parts, a carrier board, an assembly film | [`docs/reviews/dc-01/r03`](docs/reviews/dc-01/r03) | | Robot arm | A printable arm, with gated plates | [`builds/robot-arm-print-assembly`](builds/robot-arm-print-assembly) | | Nodestack | Modular industrial storage | [`docs/reviews/nodestack/r03`](docs/reviews/nodestack/r03) |

DC-01 assembled, and the printable robot arm open in a real Blender 5.2 window. Print plates for the arm are in [`docs/images/readme/builds/print-plates.jpg`](docs/images/readme/builds/print-plates.jpg) and [`docs/media/robot-arm-print-plates.png`](docs/media/robot-arm-print-plates.png). ## How it works

The MCP server exposes **four tools**. That is the count in `src/design_os_3d_blender_mcp/server.py` on this branch: | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `blender_runtime_status` | Host, Python, and whether a Blender 5.2 binary is on the path. Call this first. | | `query_blender_knowledge` | Search the verified bpy 5.2 knowledge base in `knowledge/` before writing a script. | | `validate_part_spec` | Check a `spec.json`: units in mm, target dimensions, tolerance, minimum wall. | | `execute_blender_pass` | Run a headless pass and read the `AGENT_OK` or `AGENT_FAIL` line. | Two prompts (`design_parametric_part`, `review_geometry_gate`) and two resources (`blender://knowledge/index`, `blender://specs/bracket-example`) sit next to the tools. They are not extra tools. Every executed pass ends with one machine-readable line. Exit codes alone are not a verdict. The 3D-print production gate checks manifold geometry, wall thickness and millimeter-locked bounds. Worked specs live in `specs/` and `builds/`. The Claude Code, Codex and other agent plugins install the same skill, [`skills/design-os-3d-blender/SKILL.md`](skills/design-os-3d-blender/SKILL.md). `/doctor` is a read-only diagnostic. `python3 scripts/self_check.py` is the offline repository check: it prints `ok: design-os-3d-blender self-check passed (design-os-3d-blender)` and exits 0 when the manifests and contracts match. Nothing in the server sends data off your machine. See [`PRIVACY.md`](PRIVACY.md). ## Install Choose the setup that matches your agent. Every option uses the same skill at `skills/design-os-3d-blender/SKILL.md`. ### Claude Code ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender /plugin install design-os-3d-blender@design-os-3d-blender ``` ### OpenAI Codex ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender.git /tmp/design-os-3d-blender mkdir -p ~/.codex/skills/design-os-3d-blender ~/.codex/prompts cp -R /tmp/design-os-3d-blender/skills/design-os-3d-blender/* ~/.codex/skills/design-os-3d-blender/ cp /tmp/design-os-3d-blender/prompts/doctor.md ~/.codex/prompts/design-os-3d-blender-doctor.md rm -rf /tmp/design-os-3d-blender ``` ### Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender.git /tmp/design-os-3d-blender mkdir -p ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-3d-blender cp -R /tmp/design-os-3d-blender/skills/design-os-3d-blender/* ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-3d-blender/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os-3d-blender ``` ### OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf and other agent harnesses ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender.git /tmp/design-os-3d-blender mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills/design-os-3d-blender cp -R /tmp/design-os-3d-blender/skills/design-os-3d-blender/* ~/.agents/skills/design-os-3d-blender/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os-3d-blender ```
Verify or uninstall **Verify:** ```bash python3 scripts/self_check.py ``` Or run `/doctor` inside Claude Code or Codex to inspect installed skill paths, plugin manifests, and whether Blender is reachable. **Uninstall the skill copies:** ```bash rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/design-os-3d-blender ~/.codex/skills/design-os-3d-blender ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-3d-blender ~/.agents/skills/design-os-3d-blender ```
Prompt recipes live in [`docs/cookbook.md`](docs/cookbook.md). More setup notes are in [`docs/antigravity-setup.md`](docs/antigravity-setup.md) and [`docs/upstream-agent-integration.md`](docs/upstream-agent-integration.md). ## Limits - Sheet-metal or paperboard folding, where 2D crease patterns govern the topology: use [`design-os-origami`](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-origami). - Organic character sculpting or a full game-character rig that needs a sculptor's pass. - 2D vector UI motion: use [`design-os-svg-animation`](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation). ## Watch A FREE, source-available (PolyForm Shield) agent pipeline for Blender 5.2. Videos from the [design:os by Jang](https://www.youtube.com/@designosbyjang) channel (Vietnamese, with English terms):

- [How to use design os 3d blender repo - ep 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J2Malrlb_PM) (2:57). Episode 1: building a keyboard (CK-001) end to end: photo, spec, gates, STL and GLB export. Vietnamese. - [How to use design os 3d blender repo - ep 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LKL7ZHMz5KI) (5:34). Episode 2: the DC-01 desk robot with 29 mechanical revisions, four gated runs and a printable kit. Vietnamese. - [Fanmade 3D model for Nowa planet - by design os 3d blender](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XSKZYudfMt8) (0:27). A 27-second fan-made 3D model of the Nowa desktop product, built with design-os-3d-blender. More: [design:os by Jang on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@designosbyjang). ## DESIGN:OS This is one of the DESIGN:OS tools.
